an4.125:1.1: cattārome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.125:1.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati - tathā dutiyaṃ - tathā tatiyaṃ - tathā catutthiṃ, iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
an4.125:1.4: so tadassādeti taṃ nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati.
an4.125:1.5: tattha ṭhito tadadhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno brahmakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an4.125:1.7: tattha puthujjano yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā nirayampi gacchati tiracchānayonimpi gacchati pettivisayampi gacchati.
an4.125:1.8: bhagavato pana sāvako tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā tasmiṃ yeva bhave parinibbāyati.
an4.125:1.9: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso ayaṃ adhippayāyo idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanena yadidaṃ gatiyā upapattiyā sati.
an4.125:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco puggalo karuṇāsahagatena cetasā …pe…
an4.125:2.6: ābhassarānaṃ bhikkhave devānaṃ dve kappā āyuppamāṇaṃ …pe… muditāsahagatena cetasā …pe… subhakiṇhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an4.125:2.7: subhakiṇhānaṃ bhikkhave devānaṃ cattāro kappā āyuppamāṇaṃ …pe… upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ - tathā tatiyaṃ - tathā catutthiṃ - iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati. so tadassādeti taṃ nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati. tattha ṭhito tadadhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno vehapphalānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an4.125:2.9: tattha puthujjano yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā nirayampi gacchati. tiracchānayonimpi gacchati. pettivisayampi gacchati.
an4.125:2.10: bhagavato pana sāvako tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā tasmiṃ yeva bhave parinibbāyati.
an4.125:2.11: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso, ayaṃ adhippayāyo. idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanena yadidaṃ gatiyā upapattiyā sati.
an4.125:2.12: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
